messages.content:
这是 OpenClaw 的 Meta-Agent 标准配置：

```json
{
  "name": "meta-agent",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "OpenClaw 元代理 - 智能任务路由与子代理调度",
  "engine": {
    "provider": "anthropic",
    "model": "claude-3.5-sonnet"
  },
  "routing": {
    "strategy": "semantic_match",
    "confidence_threshold": 0.7,
    "fallback_agent": "general-assistant"
  },
  "sub_agents": [
    {
      "name": "code-reviewer",
      "description": "代码审查与质量分析",
      "trigger_keywords": ["审查", "review", "代码质量", "bug", "重构"],
      "skill_path": "skills/code_review.md"
    },
    {
      "name": "data-analyst",
      "description": "数据分析与可视化",
      "trigger_keywords": ["分析数据", "图表", "统计", "报告"],
      "skill_path": "skills/data_analyst.md"
    },
    {
      "name": "translator",
      "description": "多语言翻译与本地化",
      "trigger_keywords": ["翻译", "translate", "本地化"],
      "skill_path": "skills/translator.md"
    },
    {
      "name": "general-assistant",
      "description": "通用问答与日常任务",
      "is_default": true,
      "skill_path": "skills/general_assistant.md"
    }
  ],
  "toolkit": {
    "allowed_tools": [
      "fs/read_file",
      "fs/write_file",
      "exec/shell",
      "http/request"
    ],
    "sandbox_mode": "restricted"
  },
  "memory": {
    "vector_store": "chromadb",
    "session_retention": 24,
    "max_context_tokens": 12000
  }
}
```

---

**配置说明**

| 字段 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `routing.strategy` | `semantic_match` 语义匹配、`keyword` 关键词匹配、`llm_router` 用 LLM 判断 |
| `confidence_threshold` | 匹配阈值，低于此值降级到 fallback_agent |
| `trigger_keywords` | 触发该子代理的关键词，空数组表示需语义判断 |
| `skill_path` | 指向具体技能定义文件（Markdown 格式） |
| `sandbox_mode` | `restricted` 受限 / `full` 全权限 / `readonly` 只读 |

需要我进一步解释某个字段，或调整为你的实际场景吗？
